posts.text: Did some research and this is what I found on the Internet - IAF had procured these ARFF trucks in the 1980s-1990s , these were built on Tatra chassis , BEML had signed a tech transfer with Tatra to manufacture the 6x6 and 8x8 chassis so they supplied these chassis to private fabricators like Brijbasi and Bhartiya Vehicles who acted like sub-contractors and their role was to integrate the fire control systems on the vehicle .
